preconditions.description: The number of elements N is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of allowed changes K is between 0 and min(10, N-2) inclusive.
Each element in the input array A is an integer between -10^9 and 10^9 inclusive.
The input array A contains exactly N integers.

postconditions.description: The output array 'result' is an arithmetic progression and differs from the input array 'A' in at most K positions.
Among all valid arithmetic progressions achievable with at most K changes, 'result' is the most beautiful, meaning it has the smallest first element, and if tied, the smallest step.
The output array has exactly N elements.
